2608.14339.title: Clearing the Fog: Towards Installing and Refining Proactive Exploration Capabilities in LLM Agents
2608.14339.paper_summary: We study proactive exploration in LLM agents, i.e., the ability to explore an environment to acquire information that improves future decision-making. In this regard, we first identify two fundamental bottlenecks that hinder this capability and then propose \ours, a novel method designed to instill and refine proactive exploration. Specifically, \ours\ consists of two components: (1) Exploratory Data Construction, which synthesizes exploration-rich trajectories to mitigate the hindsight bias of standard demonstrations; and (2) RL Optimization with Contrastive Signal Guidance, which leverages contrastive trajectory pairs to distinguish productive exploration from redundant wandering. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of \ours\ and provide insights into the characteristics of proactive exploration. Our code is available at: https://github.com/GuanZhizhao/SAFARI.
2608.14339.paper_summary_zh: 我們研究 LLM 代理中的主動探索，即探索環境以獲取改善未來決策的信息的能力。<lb/>在這方面，我們首先確定了兩個基本瓶頸，這些瓶頸妨礙了這種能力，然後提出 \ours，一種旨在培養和完善主動探索的新方法。<lb/>具體而言，\ours 包含兩個組件：（1）探索數據構建，合成豐富的探索軌跡以減輕標準演示的事後偏見；以及（2）帶有對比信號指導的強化學習優化，利用對比軌跡對來區分有效探索與冗餘徘徊。<lb/>大量實驗證明了 \ours 的有效性，並提供了對主動探索特徵的深入見解。<lb/>我們的代碼可在以下網址獲得：https://github.com/GuanZhizhao/SAFARI。
